description: Suggested next questions after an answer; a tap sends the suggestion as the person's next message.

howToUse: Show two to four suggestions right under the assistant's answer.
Write each one as the person would say it. When the message sent should be longer, use `{ label, message }`.
`onSelect` receives the message; your app sends it like any other message.
alternatives: Filters that change the current view: Chip or ToggleGroup.
Actions on an item: Button or ButtonGroup.
